{{velocity}} ## Displays and saves the basic authentication settings of the JIRA instances, for the JIRA administration section (see ## the org.xwiki.contrib.jira.authconfig UIX extension point). The settings are stored in ## JIRA.JIRAAuth.BasicAuthConfiguration, as one JIRA.JIRAAuth.BasicAuthClass object per instance ID. ## * GET, without "action": the settings of the instance with the given "id" (empty for a new instance), with labels ## depending on the "deploymentType". Nothing is saved. ## * POST action=saveInstance: saves the "username" and the "password" of the instance "id", renamed from "previousId" ## when it's not empty. An empty "previousId" means a new instance, which doesn't reuse settings left for the same ID. ## A missing parameter or an empty password keeps the current value. ## * POST action=deleteInstance: removes the settings of the instance "id". #set ($basicAuthClass = 'JIRA.JIRAAuth.BasicAuthClass') #set ($confDoc = $xwiki.getDocument('JIRA.JIRAAuth.BasicAuthConfiguration')) ## Render the translation specific to the deployment type (i.e. "key.deploymentType"), provided by the extension ## contributing the deployment type, falling back on the generic translation. Nothing is rendered if none of them exist. #macro (jiraBasicAuthTranslation $key) #set ($deploymentTypeKey = "${key}.$!{request.deploymentType}") #if ("$!request.deploymentType" != '' && "$!services.localization.get($deploymentTypeKey)" != '') $services.localization.render($deploymentTypeKey, 'html/5.0')## #elseif ("$!services.localization.get($key)" != '') $services.localization.render($key, 'html/5.0')## #end #end ## Sets $basicAuthObjects: the settings objects of the given instance ID. #macro (jiraBasicAuthGetObjects $jiraBasicAuthId) #set ($basicAuthObjects = []) #foreach ($candidate in $confDoc.getObjects($basicAuthClass)) #if ("$!candidate" != '' && "$!candidate.getValue('id')" == $jiraBasicAuthId) #set ($discard = $basicAuthObjects.add($candidate)) #end #end #end #macro (jiraBasicAuthError $status $message) #set ($discard = $response.setStatus($status)) #jsonResponse({'error': $message}) #end #macro (jiraBasicAuthSaveDocument $comment) #set ($discard = $confDoc.setHidden(true)) #set ($authors = $confDoc.getAuthors()) #set ($discard = $authors.setCreator($services.user.superAdminUserReference)) #set ($discard = $authors.setContentAuthor($services.user.superAdminUserReference)) #set ($discard = $authors.setEffectiveMetadataAuthor($services.user.superAdminUserReference)) #set ($discard = $authors.setOriginalMetadataAuthor($services.user.superAdminUserReference)) #set ($discard = $confDoc.save($comment, true)) #end #macro (jiraBasicAuthSaveInstance) #set ($instanceId = $stringtool.trimToEmpty($request.id)) #set ($previousId = "$!request.previousId") #if ($instanceId == '') #jiraBasicAuthError(400, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.idRequired')) #else #if ($previousId == '') ## A new instance: the settings left for the same ID (e.g. by an instance whose settings couldn't be deleted) ## aren't reused, they're replaced. #set ($basicAuthObjects = []) #else ## Keep the settings of the instance when its ID is changed. #jiraBasicAuthGetObjects($previousId) #if ($basicAuthObjects.isEmpty()) #jiraBasicAuthGetObjects($instanceId) #end #end #if ($basicAuthObjects.isEmpty()) #set ($basicAuthObject = $confDoc.newObject($basicAuthClass)) #else #set ($basicAuthObject = $basicAuthObjects.get(0)) #end ## Only one settings object per instance ID. #set ($basicAuthObjectNumber = $basicAuthObject.number) #jiraBasicAuthGetObjects($instanceId) #foreach ($duplicate in $basicAuthObjects) #if ($duplicate.number != $basicAuthObjectNumber) #set ($discard = $confDoc.removeObject($duplicate)) #end #end #set ($discard = $basicAuthObject.set('id', $instanceId)) #if ($request.getParameter('username') != $NULL) #set ($discard = $basicAuthObject.set('username', $request.getParameter('username'))) #end #if ("$!request.password" != '') #set ($discard = $basicAuthObject.set('password', $request.password)) #end #jiraBasicAuthSaveDocument("Saved the basic authentication of the JIRA instance [$instanceId]") #jsonResponse({'id': $instanceId}) #end #end #macro (jiraBasicAuthDeleteInstance) #set ($instanceId = $stringtool.trimToEmpty($request.id)) #jiraBasicAuthGetObjects($instanceId) #if ($instanceId != '' && !$basicAuthObjects.isEmpty()) #foreach ($basicAuthObject in $basicAuthObjects) #set ($discard = $confDoc.removeObject($basicAuthObject)) #end #jiraBasicAuthSaveDocument("Removed the basic authentication of the JIRA instance [$instanceId]") #end #jsonResponse({'id': $instanceId}) #end #if ($xcontext.action == 'get') #if (!$xwiki.hasAdminRights()) #jiraBasicAuthError(403, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.notAllowed')) #elseif ("$!request.action" != '') #if ($request.method != 'POST' || !$services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.form_token)) #jiraBasicAuthError(403, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.invalidRequest')) #elseif ($request.action == 'saveInstance') #jiraBasicAuthSaveInstance #elseif ($request.action == 'deleteInstance') #jiraBasicAuthDeleteInstance #else #jiraBasicAuthError(400, $services.localization.render('jira.config.error.invalidRequest')) #end #else ## Show the settings of the instance. #set ($username = '') #set ($hasPassword = false) #set ($instanceId = "$!request.id") #if ($instanceId != '') #jiraBasicAuthGetObjects($instanceId) #if (!$basicAuthObjects.isEmpty()) #set ($username = "$!basicAuthObjects.get(0).getValue('username')") #set ($hasPassword = "$!basicAuthObjects.get(0).getValue('password')" != '') #end #end {{html clean="false"}}
#if ($hasPassword) #jiraBasicAuthTranslation('jira.config.auth.keepSecret') #end
{{/html}} #end #end {{/velocity}}
